story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Use Eligibility Date as transaction effective date for new enrollment before eligibility begins

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: No Test Step Expected Result in id "TC_TS_001_002" describes an error, rejection, or absent record; examples include "The file is accepted and the transmission shows Disposition Completed and Validation Status Accepted." and "The transaction effective date displayed is 01/31/2025, which is the first applicable eligibility date in the file."

scenarios.title: Use Assessment Date as transaction effective date for current eligibility when Assessment Date changes

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS002_003 is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record; examples include "The file is present in the Arkansas archive folder after processing pickup.", "The transmission row for the submitted file is displayed.", and "The file is archived and traceable, but no new eligibility row and no new assessment-date-driven transaction effective date are created for the member, confirming the boundary condition is handled without an incorrect update."

scenarios.title: Use changed Assessment Date while preserving relevant field values when no relevant fields changed
Use Eligibility Date for future eligibility changes to relevant fields when Assessment Date is unchanged

flagged.why: the negative case is out of scope

gaps: Name field contains off-topic intent not supported by the scenario acceptance criteria: "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 is rejected when future Rate Cell change is submitted without a future Eligibility Date while Assessment Date is unchanged"

Description field contains off-topic intent not supported by the scenario acceptance criteria: "Validate for AR PASSE that a future eligibility change for Rate Cell is not accepted for this rule path when the file omits the required future Eligibility Date even though Assessment Date remains unchanged and the member eligibility span has not started."

scenarios.title: Use Maintenance Date only for current eligibility changes to relevant fields when Assessment Date is unchanged
Do not use Maintenance Date for scenarios where Eligibility Date or Assessment Date should drive the transaction effective date
Use first date occurrence when multiple inbound dates of the same type are present
